# maple_scrape_target (Resource)

A Prometheus-format endpoint Maple scrapes for metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "maple_scrape_target" "node_exporter" {
  name                    = "node-exporter"
  url                     = "https://metrics.example.com/metrics"
  scrape_interval_seconds = 30
  auth_type               = "bearer"
  auth_credentials        = var.metrics_token
  service_name            = "infra"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `auth_credentials` (String, Sensitive) Credentials for `auth_type`. Write-only in the API.
- `auth_type` (String) `none` (default), `bearer`, `basic` or `token`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the target is scraped. Defaults to `true`.
- `exclude_branches` (List of String) `planetscale`: skip these branches.
- `include_branches` (List of String) `planetscale`: only scrape these branches.
- `labels_json` (String) Extra labels added to every series, as a JSON object string.
- `organization` (String) `planetscale`: the PlanetScale organization.
- `scrape_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between scrapes, 5 to 300.
- `service_name` (String) `service.name` given to the scraped series.
- `target_type` (String) `prometheus` (default), `planetscale` or `supabase`. Changing it replaces the target.
- `url` (String) The metrics endpoint to scrape.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The `scrp_…` public ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import maple_scrape_target.example <id>
```
